blockers.quote: That night. Dadi's phone, face up on the dabba, an account she has never used. BALANCE: 1. Clack. 2. Kabir's day-three theory was right: it's her rupee.
blockers.why: No new power rule after the halfway point: the ending reveals that the power follows the rupee, contradicting the stated rule that your balance doubles and weakening the zero-at-midnight victory.
blockers.fix: Replace with: “That night, Kabir opens the loan map. Every marker is gone. Messages fill his phone from people waking up debt-free. ‘Bro. What did we change?’”

blockers.why: Checks #2 and #3 fail: the thumbnail situation arrives after seven seconds, and the doubling promise is not guaranteed within the first ten to fifteen seconds.
blockers.fix: Open on the exact thumbnail frame at 0:00 and begin: “Every midnight, your money doubles. Day thirty-one: this screen can buy your whole lane. Tonight it doubles again—and the people you love pay for it.”

blockers.quote: That's all a note ever was. Not a thing. Mangesh bhaiya's notebook, with the whole country's handwriting in it.
blockers.why: Check #12 fails: this summarizes the lesson after the story has already shown it instead of leaving inside the final image.
blockers.fix: Replace with: “Mangesh bhaiya: ‘Still checking?’ You lock the phone and point to the notebook. He writes ten.”

suggestions.quote: The choice is morally live: you promised Baba his eleven; respecting him leaves too much to reach zero, using them breaks your word.
suggestions.fix: Do not call this morally live when preventing national collapse clearly wins. Make the beat about earning Baba's consent before midnight, or add a consequence that makes preserving his loan genuinely defensible.

suggestions.quote: Bro. Double is double. Double is always more.
suggestions.fix: Make this cause the next beat: “Therefore you make him prove it: you each write down day thirty-one before he runs the program.”

suggestions.quote: Six p.m. RTGS runs all night with no upper limit (to source at G2).
suggestions.fix: Let the first repayment total fail because balances changed during the day, forcing Kabir to rerun his planted program and calculate the live remainder before Baba offers the eleven.

keep.quote: If I had all the money, would there be anything left to buy?
